It models procedure calls explicitly using a program-counter variable pc and a stack of activation-record-like records that save return locations and local variables across calls. The specification checks correct argument passing, local variable initialization, and return behavior using runtime assertions translated to TLC Assert calls, and it verifies both a standard temporal specification with weak fairness on Next and an eventual termination property stating that execution eventually reaches pc = "Done".
